topic_lines: # Run from the course folder with the new 64-bit R installation.
# This script is safe to rerun: it installs missing packages and GitHub updates.
# Package installation child processes must not load the course .Rprofile
# before rutils exists or hold startup package DLLs open during reinstalls.
# Capture compiler output from a clean R process so that only a confirmed
# Armadillo C++ standard mismatch can enable the HighFreq compatibility build.
# R 4.6 may reject the removed CXX11 setting before reaching Armadillo's
# headers. Handle that exact diagnostic only when CXX17 is configured.
# install_local writes local-remote metadata. Restore the pinned GitHub
# provenance in both DESCRIPTION and Meta/package.rds for future SHA checks.
# FRE7241 package manifest. Keep the professor's requirements explicit.
# Additional packages used in the downloaded lecture material.
# Solvers for the portfolio optimization examples.
# Useful extras for clear charts, interactive output, reports, and reproducibility.
# Run from the course folder: Rscript --vanilla course-setup/verify-setup.R

review_notes.template_mismatch: Template SPY ends 2026-05-08 and stock universe has 1000 stocks/5119 dates. Neither current installed package nor bundled course files match that exact snapshot. Do not fabricate or adjust data to force reference results.
review_notes.HighFreq_run_var_argument: Installed formal parameter is lambdaf; assignment lambda= succeeds via R partial argument matching. Explicit lambdaf= avoids partial matching.
review_notes.Hampel_reference: strategies_univariate.pdf pages 88-90; log prices, rolling median and normal-consistent MAD, threshold 1, retained positions until opposite signal, lag one observation, log-price differences as PnL inputs.
review_notes.Sortino_reference: rutils::calc_sharpe uses sample standard deviation of negative observations as denominator, not downside RMS deviation.
